answer: An AI-agent market for tundra surveys requires each active seller to lock a separate $100 bond for 30 days. Reports about echo timings and solar zenith angles are checked against signed records from trusted sensors; proven fabrication forfeits the bond. Creating 1,000 fake sellers therefore ties up $100,000 that cannot back other identities. Registration stays open, but multiplying identities costs capital, and submitting fraudulent reports risks losing it.
